name: Specification
description: "Ayre's first preamp.It supports balanced transmission.The amplifier circuit adopts a fully discrete configuration using FET, and is a non-NFB configuration that penetrates to the power supply.The volume part is equipped with four 1 db step 46 silver contact resistance switching attenuators.By using a mechanical belt drive for volume adjustment, high reliability is ensured, and remote control is also available.The power supply section is equipped with a toroidal power transformer.By adopting direct path technology such as surface mounting as well as input / output terminal directly mounted on the board, the signal path is short-circuited to the limit.The power supply unit has a separate housing to eliminate the influence of the power supply unit, and internal wiring is eliminated as much as possible except for the power supply line.High-frequency noise is eliminated by using a choke coil for the filter.Wireless remote control is included.An optional discrete phono amplifier can be set up in the enclosure."

name: Specification
description: This is a preamplifier that condensed the essence of sound design and realized a more reasonable price.Equipped with two 1 dB step pure silver 46 contact resistance switching attenuators.The amplifier circuit is a fully discrete configuration using FET.A non-NFB configuration is provided up to the power supply.The power supply section uses a choke input filter to reduce RF noise.Direct Path Technology is thoroughly applied. name: K-5X
description: "A preamplifier incorporating the latest technology while inheriting the tradition of air acoustics from the past.Fully balanced circuit configuration is used from input to output.In addition, the 0 feedback design is adopted following the conventional tradition, and the sound with high freshness is realized.The volume section uses a resistance switching type volume using a metal film resistor of 1 dB and 66 steps. The volume can be changed by switching this volume with an FET switch.This realizes smooth volume operation while maintaining the high sound quality of the resistance switching volume, and eliminates noise generation due to contact deterioration, which was a weak point of the resistance switching attenuator, by eliminating moving parts.Remote control is also available, and the volume value is displayed on the indicator.Two input terminals, balanced and unbalanced, are installed.An FET switch is also used in the selector circuit to reliably shut off both the hot and cold sides, and to suppress noise generation during switching by eliminating moving parts.The built-in microprocessor is designed to be powered off all the time except during processing, eliminating the effect on sound quality.In consideration of both pure audio and home theater, the Processor Pass-Through mode can be set for each input. This feature allows the input from the AV processor to bypass the volume circuit.Wireless remote control is included."

name: V-5X
description: "A stereo power amplifier developed by refining the V-5.We have adopted a full balance and 0 feedback design in keeping with tradition.An FET is used for the input stage, a bipolar type is used for the output stage, and a current mirror circuit is used for the input circuit to improve the ability to eliminate disturbances related to power supply and improve the stability of DC voltage.The output stage is based on the T-circuit developed by Mr. Bart Locanthi in the mid 1960 s and has been improved with new ideas. This circuit was developed using RF-""neutralization""technology to ensure stability regardless of speaker or cable load.A BIAS-LOK circuit has been developed to ensure that the bias current of the bipolar output stage is kept close to the critical value for maximum sound quality.This circuit is designed to maintain an ideal operating condition regardless of load and temperature conditions, while reducing idle power and heat generation significantly as a secondary effect.The power transformer uses an EI core type with excellent sound quality and excellent S/N characteristics.The power supply circuit uses the well-established ""air conditioner"" Lian filter.This allows for faithful playback regardless of AC power status, while reducing the overall noise level.Thick solid aluminum is used for the finish of the face plate, and the corners are smoothly curved.The heat sink is installed inside the unit to avoid external projections, and the legs are designed to be compact and easy to install.Both balanced and unbalanced inputs are supported.Equipped with a pass-through output terminal, it can be used for distribution to bi-amplifier and tri-amplifier.Equipped with trigger input terminal for remote power ON.There are 2 color variations of silver and black."
